scripts.dev: npm run build -w @central/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @central/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @central/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
